exposure: More than three prior cesarean deliveries
Deviation from American Society for Reproductive Medicine (ASRM) safety guidelines for gestational carriers
Deviation from ASRM guidelines for gestational carriers
Gestational carrier pregnancies that deviated from guidelines vs. those that did not
Age younger than 21 years or older than 45 years
outcome: Severe obstetric morbidity and mortality (death within 1 year of delivery, intensive care unit admission, eclampsia, HELLP syndrome, transfusion, unplanned hysterectomy)
cohort: 361 gestational carrier deliveries of 435 neonates in Utah from 2009 to 2018
finding: Deviation from ASRM guidelines for gestational carriers was associated with increased rates of cesarean delivery, neonatal morbidity, and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Deviation from ASRM guidelines for gestational carriers was associated with an increased rate of cesarean delivery.
